import {
  Center,
  ChakraProvider,
  Input,
  Box,
  Button,
  Flex,
  Heading
} from '@chakra-ui/react'

import { login } from './services/login';

function App() {
  return (
    <ChakraProvider>

      {/* HEADER */}
      <Flex
        as="header"
        bg="blue.500"
        color="white"
        padding="5px"
        justify="space-between"
        align="center"
      >
      <Center>  
        <Heading size="md">Meu Sistema</Heading>
      </Center>
      </Flex>

      {/* CONTEÚDO */}
      <Box minHeight='100vh' backgroundColor='#9413dc' padding='25px'>

        <Box
          backgroundColor='#FFFFFF'
          borderRadius='25px'
          padding='15px'
          maxWidth='400px'
          margin='0 auto'
        >

          <Center marginBottom='20px'>
            <Heading size='md'>Faça o login</Heading>
          </Center>

          <Input
            placeholder="email"
            marginBottom='10px'
          />

          <Input
            placeholder="password"
            type='password'
            marginBottom='10px'
          />

          <Center>
            <Button
              onClick={login}
              colorScheme='teal'
              size='sm'
              width='100%'
            >
              Login
            </Button>
          </Center>

        </Box>
      </Box>
    </ChakraProvider>
  );
}

export default App;
